NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 5 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 11 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 11, 3:12 PM ET

The Texans are the top-projected defense on the Week 5 DraftKings main slate at 7.8 DraftKings points for $3,400, at Tennessee. Broncos (7.0, $3,200) and Vikings (7.0, $3,100) are next.

The Browns return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.36 projected points per $1,000 at $2,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 11, 3:12 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 5

Texans, HOU at TEN ($3,400)

Texans carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.8 DraftKings points at $3,400. That is 0.8 points clear of Broncos. The salary works out to 2.30 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 9 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Texans averaged 8.0 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.7, and it holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 22 in a game totaled at 37.5.

Value: Browns, CLE at NYJ ($2,800)

Browns projects for 6.6 DraftKings points at $2,800, which works out to 2.36 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 9 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Browns averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 16.3, and it holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cleveland is a 2.5-point underdog on the road against the Jets, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 38.5.
